title: The Gallery Bends
description: Past the seam the gallery bends left, and the bend is
where the stone stops being grey and starts being white,
which no photograph of this hill has ever explained.
The glare is next: a canyon of calcite and dripstone
where the light comes in from above and bounces until
the walls give it back with interest. Squinting is the
Six stations, the same six, in white. Grey to white to
green: the descent changes clothes and keeps walking.
The drips go on behind you for a long time. They are the
only thing the gallery ever says goodbye with.
